_comment: Nothing here is required. Every installation is discovered at run time (uninstall registry, App Paths, running processes, <drive>:\Program Files*\WorkBuddy*, %USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy*), and one deploy run updates all of them. Fill installPath / configDir only to pin a specific installation; set default only to make a bare `apply.ps1` / `verify.ps1` call pick one target.
